runtime_canvas.decode_policy: five layers of one theme only

performance_note: Per-layer sizes are initial compressed-delivery ceilings in KB, not guaranteed device budgets. Benchmark total decode/GPU memory, cold navigation and frame pacing before substitution.

themes.name: Dawn Valley
themes.art_direction: warm ochre sunrise, muted sage, restrained glowing valley mist

layers.notes: Full-bleed sunrise/moonlit atmosphere; preserve light-source anchor (warm 1170, slate 1230) under mobile center crops

Mid-range ridge material, softened intermediate contrast and readable rock facets
Sparse translucent atmosphere with no hard rectangular silhouettes or seams
Foreground forest tree silhouettes, restrained highlights, edge-accurate wrap
